title: CustomEmojiCard::Asked is settled only by the card render; no timeout or owner-gone exit
trigger: Tap a custom emoji (Asked{request}), then the reply never arrives or the chat/pane is left before a render that builds the card
effect: Asked stays set and the answer sits in session.stickers.custom_emoji_answers; a later render can pop the card in an unrelated chat
fix: Clear Asked when the tapped chat closes or the account changes, and drain custom_emoji_answers from the poll rather than from render

title: dismissed_keyboards and collapsed_keyboards are append-only sets keyed by ChatMessage that nothing prunes
trigger: Press a one-time keyboard button or toggle the keyboard collapse in many chats over a long session
effect: Sets grow for the life of the window; dismissed state is also kept when deleteChatReplyMarkup failed (local hide stands, never retried)
fix: Hold the keyboard stage (Shown/Collapsed/Dismissed) on the chat's ChatUi next to the reply markup so it dies with the chat, and keep the delete request id in the stage

title: Invite preview kept twice: the session's DeepLinkState::InvitePreview and screen.links.invite_box.request()
trigger: Open an invite link, then click another link while the box is up
effect: Two owners of one stage are kept in step by hand (take(), end_deep_link_flow, cancel_deep_link_invite); today every path clears both
fix: Make the box a view of the flow stage (derive is_open from deep_link_stage) instead of storing the request again

title: hold_resolved_link overwrites an unconsumed ResolvedLink
trigger: Two typed links resolve before the frame that runs the first (window minimized, locked)
effect: The first resolved link is dropped silently; only the newest runs
fix: A queue of resolved steps, or an explicit Replaced note

title: Focus-after-mount is kept three ways: Mount enum, focus_on_mount Option<Entity> slot, and a bare focus_on_mount: bool
trigger: Open the Promote admin dialog, a poll, a checklist, or the composer shortcuts dialog
effect: No bug today (each is taken on the first draw), but the bool in AdminDialogKind::Promote and the Option slots in PollDialog, PollAddOption, ChecklistDialog and composer_shortcuts are the old flag in disguise next to ui::mount::Mount
fix: Use mount::Mount in every box and keep the field entity separately

title: CommunityUi::hub_open is a bare open flag beside create_dialog: Option<..>
trigger: Open the communities hub, then New community
effect: The hub and create box are two separate open markers closed by hand in each handler (close_community_hub then open_create_community_dialog); nothing stops both being set
fix: One CommunityBox enum { Closed, Hub, Create(CreateCommunityDialog) }

title: AddContactDialog uses user_id == 0 to pick which half of AddContactStage is legal
trigger: Open New Contact (user_id 0) vs Add Contact (user_id != 0)
effect: Importing/NotJoined are only valid for user_id 0 and Saving/Failed only for user_id != 0, enforced by convention across the upkeep code
fix: Two dialog types, or AddContactStage split into NewContact(Stage) and AddContact(user_id, Stage)

title: VideoChatCreate::Sent and the Created stream wish settle only in an upkeep gated by the GroupCallStart dialog's host window
trigger: Press Start in a chat window, Create (start_dialog is cleared before the send), then close that chat window before the answer
effect: dialog_may_show_in(GroupCallStart) is true only for the last-pressed window, so the main window's upkeep never matches the failed/answered create; create stays Sent until the registry sweep (video_chat_create_in_flight self-heals) but the stream_wish Created intent is not cleared on a refusal
fix: Run the create answer matching from poll_live (account scope) instead of per-window frame upkeep, and keep the request in the stage

title: MemberDialog::add_open bool with add_selected and add_search kept in step by hand
trigger: Open Members, expand Add members, tick contacts, switch tab
effect: add_selected is not cleared when add_open turns false or the tab changes unless each handler does so
fix: MemberAdd enum { Closed, Picking{selected} } owned by the dialog

title: Terms delete failure writes session.settings.account_write directly from a click handler
trigger: Decline terms, Delete now, driver.delete_account refused
effect: The UI forges AccountWrite::Refused on the session instead of the driver recording it, so a stage is reset by hand from outside its own transitions
fix: Have delete_account record its own refusal like accept_terms does
